sources.entry: Übersicht - Keep an eye on what's happening on your machine and in the world.

summary.one_liner: Übersicht is a macOS desktop app that displays customizable widgets, written as JavaScript/JSX files, on your screen.
summary.what_it_does: Widgets are single .jsx files that export properties such as command, refreshFrequency, className, render, updateState, initialState and init. A command is a shell command or a function whose output is passed to render, which is built with React and JSX. Übersicht watches the widget directory and reloads widgets on file changes, keeping state across edits for live coding. Widgets can use Emotion-based css and styled helpers for styling, and the run function to execute extra shell commands. The app also provides a geolocation API with an extra address property, a built-in proxy server for external requests, and AppleScript support for refreshing or listing widgets. The README also covers building the app from source with Node and Xcode.
use_cases: display system information on the desktop
show live data widgets on macOS desktop
run shell commands periodically and show output
build custom desktop dashboards with React
fetch external data for a desktop widget
how_to_run: brew install node@8 && brew link --force node@8
notable: Widgets are plain .jsx modules with live reload and state kept across edits
Commands can be shell strings or functions that dispatch events into a Redux-like updateState
Custom geolocation API under window.geolocation that adds an address field
Built-in proxy server for Ajax requests without a shell command
AppleScript support for refreshing and listing widgets
caveats: Building from source requires Node 8 and a Homebrew-based setup, plus manual Xcode code-signing changes
Click events need an interaction shortcut and accessibility access enabled
The geolocation implementation is described as basic and possibly unstable, and error reporting is not implemented
